The whole ladder closes independently: 40.29 + 1,142.07 = 1,182.36 (line 5), minus line 6 1,182.36 = line 7, a SLASHED ZERO read 0 under the zero-glyph ruling.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contributions side - both conventions tested on both sides, as ADDENDUM G1 requires. Three of the four Schedule A rows are marked '(In Kind)' by the filer inside the name cell and total 98.71; monetary-only would give 1,043.36 and FAILS Column A by exactly that 98.71, while monetary-plus-in-kind gives 1,142.07 and closes to the cent against all three printed anchors. So this filer's in-kind gifts sit INSIDE his stated cash-column figure. Schedule B marks no row in-kind, so both conventions are identical there and both close at 1,182.36. NOTE the in-kind gifts are NOT double-entered as offsetting expenditures - except that the IT Solutions 60.00 web-hosting appears on BOTH schedules, and it has to: the ledger closes on both sides only with it counted once per side.
itemized.escalation_note: No figure needed correcting; every amount reproduced its full-page reading. ADDENDUM G2 (a value overflowing its printed column) applies to THIS WHOLE FILING, not to one row: crops bounded on the amount column's own detected rules (82.25-91.78 on p3, 82.24-91.60 on p4) CLIPPED the last digit or the raised cents of every tested cell - p3 row 2 rendered '34.' and row 4 '$1,04', p4 row 1 rendered only the address tail. Re-rendered with the box widened to x=82.0 w=17.0, every cell renders in full (p3: 60.00 / 34.44 / 4.27 / 1,043.36; p4 row 1 60.00, row 2 605.20, row 3 29.55, row 10 4.27). EVERY transcribed row therefore carries an EXPLICIT WIDENED geometry string, which wins over the page frame; the frames still record the honest measurement of the printed grid.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

itemized.notes: Bryan E. Thompson, page-face office 'Utah County Clerk/Auditor', party 'Republican'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote the name through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). 4 pages, legacy_colAB: p1 cover ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', signed 4/20/18, clerk stamp '18 APR 20 AM10:48), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B, foliated by hand 'Page 1..4 of 4' INCLUDING the cover (the cover's '1 of 4' is written free-hand in the top margin, there being no foliation box on the cover blank). *** THIS IS THE CLEANEST INSTANCE OF THE TEMPLATE-VINTAGE TRAP IN THE CHUNK. *** The cover is the school-board blank titled 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES' (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13) and ALL THREE inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' - leftover 2016 stock filed in 2018, exactly ADDENDUM G5. The filing is unambiguously 2018 (signed 4/20/18, clerk-stamped APR 20 '18, every entry dated 2018). The year was NOT reclassified and the sheets are NOT a bound-in prior report. Read alongside the other three 2018 filings in this chunk, the stock is proven heterogeneous WITHIN one cycle: Grunander's inner sheets say '2018 County & Local School Candidates', Hemingway's say '2018 County Candidate(s)', Leavitt's say '2018 County & Local School Candidates', and Thompson's say '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates'. SCHEDULE B COLUMN VOCABULARY: 'Name/Nature of Expenditure' - ADDENDUM G4's third vocabulary, and a different one from the 'Provider/Vendor' heading on the other three 2018 filings in this chunk. There is still NO Purpose column: this filer appends the purpose after a HYPHEN inside the Name/Nature cell ('Amazon.com - Supplies', 'Utah County - Filing Fee'), which is the ADDENDUM E5 workaround; `purpose` is that trailing phrase and `vendor_raw` the payee, assigned BY CONTENT. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED - neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked. That is an honest BLANK, never 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). NIL MARK: summary line 7 is a SLASHED ZERO and reads 0 under the zero-glyph ruling; line 3 carries a real 40.29 beginning balance, so this is NOT a from-zero cycle. DATE NOTATION: this filer writes RANGES and COMPOUND dates in the date cell ('3/1 - 4/14/18', '3/22 + 3/23/18', '1/1/18 - 6/30/18', '3/23 - 4/10/18'). All four are kept verbatim with needs_review=1; a single date was never chosen for them and no year was ever filled in from the report date. PRIVACY: the county did NOT redact this filing; street lines are visible on both schedules and are reduced to city/state (contributions) or dropped entirely (expenditures) at read time. CROSS-CHECK WORTH RECORDING (observation only): this filing's 2018 Clerk/Auditor filing fee is 605.20, the identical figure transcribed independently from Stephen Hemingway's 2018 Clerk/Auditor filing in this same chunk - agreement within one office and one cycle, which is what ADDENDUM F5 says such agreement is worth.
